उत्था {c1c} P. [उद्-स्था]
1 To get
up, stand, rise, raise oneself;
उत्तिष्ठेत्प्रथमं चास्य

.
--3 To rise, come up (as
the sun &c.).
--4 To rebound (as a
ball); कराभिघातोत्थितकन्दुकेयं

.
--5 To come forth, arise, spring
or originate from, accrue from; ग्रा
माच्छतमुत्तिष्ठति Mbh; यदुत्तिष्ठति
वर्णेभ्यो नृपाण क्षयितत्फलं Ś. 2. 13;
अन्यदमृतादुत्थितम्

shouts of applause burst forth
(were heard);

.
--6 To rise,
increase in strength or power, grow,
(as an enemy, disease &c.); (Atm.)
उत्तिष्ठमानस्तु परो नोपेक्ष्यः पथ्यमिच्छता
Śi. 2. 10 (=

.)
--7
To become animated, rise (from
the dead); मृतेत्थिता

.
--8
To be active or brave, rise up;
हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ

.
--9 To make
efforts; take pains, strive, try;
उत्तिष्ठमानं मित्रार्थे कस्त्वां न बहु मन्यते

; उदस्थित क्रतौ
Śi. 14. 17.
--10 To excel, surpass. --Caus.
(उत्थापयति)
1 To cause to stand up,
raise, lift up: उत्थाप्यते ग्रावा

.
--3 To arouse, awaken, raise to
life, make alive; प्राणो हीदं
सर्वमुत्थापयति Śat. Br.
--4 To support, feed,
aid; अत्र परिकरोत्थापितोऽ
र्थांतरन्यासालंकारः Malli. on

उत्थ a. [उद्-स्था-क] (Used only
at the end of comp.)
1 Born or
produced from, arising, springing
up, or originating from; दरीमुखोत्थेन
समीरणेन

.
--2 Standing up, coming up
or forth.
--त्थः Arising, coming
forth.

One who rises
or gets up.
--2 Resolving.

उत्थान a. Causing to arise or
spring up.
--नं
1 The act of rising or
standing up, getting up; शनैर्यष्ट्युत्थानं

newly risen.
--3 Rise, origin.
--4
Resurrection.
--5 (a) Effort, exertion,
activity; मेदश्छेदकृशोदरं लघु
भवत्युत्थानयोग्यं वपुः Ś. 2. 5; ˚शीलः

, effort (for money),
acquisition of property. (b) Manly
exertion, manhood.
--6 Energy.
--7
Joy, pleasure.
--8 War, battle.
--9 An
army.
--10 Evacuating (by stool &c.).
--11 A book.
--12 A court yard.
--13
A shed where sacrifices are offered.
--14 A term, limit, boundary.
--15
Business (cares &c.) of a family or
realm.
--16 Reflection.
--17 Proximate
cause of a disease.
--18 Awakening.
--Comp.
--एकादशी the eleventh day
in the light fortnight of Kārttika
when Viṣṇu rises from his four
months' sleep (also called प्रबोधिनी).

उत्थापक a.
1 Raising up, causing
to get up.
--2 Exciting, instigating,
animating.

1 Causing to rise, come
up, or get up.
--2 Raising,
elevating.
--3 Causing to leave (a
house).
--4 Exciting, instigating.
--5 Awakening, rousing (fig. also).
--6 Vomiting.
--7 Finishing,
completing.
--8 Bringing about.
--9
Bringing forth.
--10 (In Math.)
Finding the quantity sought, an
answer to the question,
substitution of a value (Colebr.).
--नी The
concluding verse (ऋच्).

उत्थाप्य pot. p.
1 To be raised or
lifted.
--2 To be excited or
animated.
--3 To be mixed.

उत्थित p. p.
1 Risen or rising (as
from a seat); वचो
निशम्योत्थितमुत्थितः सन्

.
[]
--4 Born, produced, sprung up,
arisen; वचः

.
burst into a flame.
--5 Striving,
active, diligent;

; 8. 49.
--6
Increasing, growing (in strength),
advancing.
--7 Bounded up,
rebounded; पतिता उत्थिता

.
--8 Occurring.
--9 High, lofty,
eminent.
--10 Extended, stretched;
आपर्वभाग˚ Ś. 4. 4.

--अंगुलिः the palm of the
